seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Parma, Ohio for 2026: Frosty's Fest with a free photo with Santa, the Christmas Parade and a library cookie party.
seo_description: Christmas events for kids in Parma, Ohio for 2026: 4 family events, 3 free, with dates, times and addresses checked on each host's site.
intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Parma for 2026, and here is what he found: 4 family events, 3 of them free. The magic runs from December 5 (North Pole Adventure at Seven Hills City Hall) through December 14 (Cookies with Mrs. Claus). We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Parma

  • 4 Christmas events for kids in Parma
  • 3 free events: Frosty's Fest at Ridgewood Golf Club, Parma Christmas Parade, Cookies with Mrs. Claus
  • Meet Santa: Santa at Frosty's Fest (December 6) and the Seven Hills North Pole Adventure (December 5); Mrs. Claus at the library (December 14)
  • Parades and tree lightings: Christmas Parade on Ridge Road (December 6)
  • Season: December 5 to December 14

Planning a bigger day out? Parma families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Cleveland, which covers Playhouse Square, Wild Winter Lights at the Cleveland Zoo, WinterLand and holiday shows at Severance.
lede: Parma's Christmas starts with a parade and Frosty's Fest, a free party with Santa, plus a library visit from Mrs. Claus.
celebrates: Parma celebrates with the Christmas Parade on Ridge Road and Frosty's Fest, the free party at the Ridgewood Golf Club and Event Center organized by We Are Parma Proud. Families get a free photo with Santa, a kids gift, a craft and face painting, and the Parma-Powers Branch library adds an evening of cookie decorating with Mrs. Claus. Neighboring Seven Hills holds its North Pole Adventure at City Hall on December 5.
lastyear: The City of Parma's calendar listed the 2025 Christmas Parade on Sunday, December 7, 2025 at 1 pm, starting at Stearns Homestead and traveling north on Ridge Road. Cleveland.com reported that Frosty's Fest that year added an event at the Ridgewood Golf Course event center with free photos with Santa, kids' crafts, food trucks, ice sculpting and Disney princesses.
facts: The Parma Christmas Parade and Frosty's Fest are both on Sunday, December 6, 2026, with the parade at 1 pm and Frosty's Fest running from 1 to 4 pm at Ridgewood.
trains: We did not find a Christmas train ride in Parma itself. The Cuyahoga Valley Scenic Railroad runs the North Pole Adventure from Rockside Station in nearby Independence, the RTA Rapid and HealthLine serve Cleveland, and Amtrak's Lake Shore Limited stops at Cleveland Lakefront Station. Check each operator for 2026 schedules.
